title: Uvod u DevSecOps i prvi pipeline
summary: Principi DevSecOps-a (shift-left i shift-right, NIST SSDF, OWASP SAMM i DSOMM), modelovanje prijetnji za aplikaciju i pipeline i izbor kontrola po fazama, uz prvo pokretanje kurs-shop pipelinea alatom gitlab-ci-local.
title_en: Introduction to DevSecOps and the first pipeline
summary_en: DevSecOps principles (shift-left and shift-right, NIST SSDF, OWASP SAMM and DSOMM), threat modeling for the application and the pipeline and choosing controls per stage, plus a first run of the kurs-shop pipeline with gitlab-ci-local.
